0022600213.text: The Phoenix Suns (3-5, 3-2 at home, 0-3 on the road) are on a two-game winning streak, sitting 3rd in the Pacific, 4.5 games back, and 12th in the West. The LA Clippers (2-7, 0-4 on the road) are on a one-game win streak, sitting 4th in the Pacific, 6 games back, and 13th in the West, and they are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), with Cam Christie listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery), and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2 with no games yet this season, after the Suns lost 117-93 in Phoenix on February 1, 2026.
